page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m8-vws.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 10 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 46.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.6 GB per core. For acceleration, it includes a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU providing 8 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not bundled, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 7390.5 and a Passmark CPU score of 8589.71. However, single-core performance is weak to poor, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 913.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1110.19. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance for both cached and uncached reads, though Passmark memory scores fall into the weak category. The fractional GPU enables average performance for small LLM inference, such as a 135M model at 130.14 text generation tokens per second, but performance drops to poor for larger 7B models.

By utilizing a fractional 0.5x NVIDIA T4 GPU, this instance offers a resource-dense, cost-efficient profile for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand a full dedicated GPU. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage. This configuration is suitable for entry-level GPU workloads, light machine learning inference, ray tracing, image processing, and general-purpose applications requiring moderate parallel compute capabilities.
